pushUi.title: Get a reminder every evening?
pushUi.body: We only ping you when someone is not marked, or a worker needs an answer.
pushUi.bodyWorker: We'll tell you when the house marks your leave or settles your salary.
pushUi.unsupported: This browser can't show notifications. Add Staffbook to your home screen first.
pushUi.serviceTitle: Notifications are allowed, but your browser couldn't connect to its push service.
pushUi.serviceStep1: In your browser's settings, open Privacy (or Site settings) and make sure push messaging / notifications are not turned off.
pushUi.serviceStep2: If you use a VPN, ad-blocker or office network, pause it for a moment.
pushUi.serviceStep3: Close and reopen the browser, then tap the button again.
pushUi.blockedTitle: Notifications are blocked for this site.
pushUi.blockedStep1: Click the lock or settings icon on the left of the address bar.
pushUi.blockedStep2: Set Notifications to Allow (or Reset permission).
pushUi.blockedStep3: Reload the page and tap the button again.
